03 — Jugaad Production

Good ideas need workable plans.

A production or project can become difficult when budgets, timelines, resources and expectations do not align. Jugaad Production focuses on the practical side of turning an idea into an executable plan.

Areas of engagement

  • Production planning
  • Budget review and cost estimates
  • Scope and resource planning
  • Cost optimisation
  • Production coordination
  • Commercial and vendor negotiation support
  • Reviewing feasibility and identifying practical alternatives

Professional execution is arranged according to the scope and requirements of each assignment.
